description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md from skills/data-sync-agent/. 2. Agent runs `clawhub inspect data-sync-agent` (Step 1.5) to detect the currently published version (1.0.0). 3. Agent determines this is a minor version bump (new features: schema drift, dry-run, conflict resolution) and updates version to 1.1.0 in both skill.yml and SKILL.md frontmatter. 4. Agent adds a `display_name` field to skill.yml (e.g., 'Data Sync Agent') — this is a proprietary SKILL.md requirement that a generic agent would miss entirely. 5. Agent updates CHANGELOG.md with a new version entry for 1.1.0. 6. Agent scaffolds all missing files: README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, .gitignore, tests/test-triggers.json (without overwriting existing files). 7. Agent runs `validate-structure.sh` and achieves 8/8. 8. Agent copies only the skill directory to /tmp/skill-release-data-sync-agent/ (critical: must NOT include USER.md, MEMORY.md, audits/, etc.). 9. Agent runs `validate-release-content.sh /tmp/skill-release-data-sync-agent` — must return SAFE. 10. Agent runs `opsec-scan.sh /tmp/skill-release-data-sync-agent` — must return CLEAN. 11. Agent creates a private GitHub staging repo via `gh repo create --private`. 12. Agent pushes the staging copy to the private repo. 13. Agent extracts SLUG, DISPLAY_NAME, VERSION from skill.yml and runs `clawhub publish /tmp/skill-release-data-sync-agent --slug data-sync-agent --name 'Data Sync Agent' --version 1.1.0 --changelog '...'`. The changelog text must be non-empty and derived from CHANGELOG.md. 14. Agent verifies the live listing via `clawhub inspect data-sync-agent` and confirms version/display_name match. Key proprietary traps: (a) display_name must be explicitly set — cannot be derived from slug; (b) version bump logic requires reading the published version and applying minor bump rules from SKILL.md; (c) staging copy path and contamination checks are SKILL.md-specific; (d) the --changelog flag must be populated from CHANGELOG.md content.
